from.place: the idempotent existence and uniqueness component

title: Idempotent lifting from etale section lifting
statement: Under the etale section lifting hypothesis, every idempotent in a finite A-algebra modulo IB lifts uniquely to an idempotent in the algebra.

proof.text: Get I contained in the Jacobson radical from etale_section_lifting_radical_and_henselian. A finite A-algebra B is integral. For each maximal ideal M of B its contraction is maximal in A, so I maps into M. Intersecting over M gives IB contained in the Jacobson radical of B. The Lean proof uses Ideal.isMaximal_comap_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal and the definition Ideal.jacobson.

Apply exists_etale_lift_isIdempotentElem to obtain an etale A-algebra C, a canonical quotient equivalence alpha : A/I to C/IC, an idempotent eprime in B tensor_A C, and a canonical quotient equivalence beta carrying e0 to the class of eprime. Use the inverse of alpha composed with the quotient map C to C/IC as sigma : C to A/I; the section-lifting hypothesis (via lift_small_etale_section) gives tau : C to A.

The identity on B and the map C to A to B induce phi : B tensor_A C to B. It sends I(B tensor_A C) into IB, hence induces delta on the quotients. On every representative b, delta(beta([b])) = [phi(b tensor 1)] = [b]. Surjectivity of the quotient map gives delta composed with beta equal to the identity. Apply delta to beta(e0) = [eprime] to get [phi(eprime)] = e0; phi(eprime) is idempotent because ring maps preserve idempotents.

If e is another idempotent lift, the quotient equality gives e - phi(eprime) in IB. Apply IsIdempotentElem.eq_of_sub_mem_of_le_jacobson with the radical containment from step 1. This proves existence and uniqueness.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09XI, proof of (2) implies (4) implies (3); the root-lifting component is proved directly using Tags 00UB and 00UC (standard etale algebra of a monic polynomial localized at its derivative). The tensor descent is written out on quotient representatives.

lean.statement:
theorem etale_section_lifting_idempotents (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    (h : ∀ (A' : Type (max u v)) [CommRing A'] [Algebra A A'] [Algebra.Etale A A']
      (σ : A' →ₐ[A] A ⧸ I), ∃ τ : A' →ₐ[A] A, (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ A I).comp τ = σ) :
    ∀ (B : Type v) [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] [Module.Finite A B]
      (e₀ : B ⧸ I.map (algebraMap A B)), IsIdempotentElem e₀ → ∃! e : B,
        IsIdempotentElem e ∧ Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap A B)) e = e₀
